applicability: Initial unnamed reviewer entry and a catalogue answer after SUBJECT_HOLD_MS releases task-context reading.
conditions: Pointerdown, keydown, wheel and touchstart are observed passively on the surface root; engagement is ignored while the hold is settling and never overrides an explicit same-gesture selection.
An outlined result is searched in the current persisted triage/authored order. When that outline has no real change, no subject is selected merely to force a first family.
Catalogue-first fallback applies only when no outlined result is available; a supplied named subject has priority.
exclusions: No unconditional first-family or timely-first-subject promise.
A refused or empty catalogue supplies no fabricated subject.
Persisted order preferences are not ignored.
statement: After the bounded unnamed-entry wait, an engaged reader keeps their selected subject, view and focus when the catalogue answers. An unengaged reader follows initialSubject: the first real outline change in the persisted order, otherwise the existing catalogueFirst fallback. A named subject always wins.
